designs.label: 3-hex Timber sawmill factory
designs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE canonical top-down transparent game building sprite, production art for a Godot hex-grid tactics game.
Input image 1 is a STYLE reference only: match its detailed hand-painted roof tiles/planks, crisp dark eaves, restrained rustic texture and orthographic overhead camera. Input image 2 is a STRICT FOOTPRINT AND PROPORTION GUIDE, not scenery: its grey shape is the desired connected building plan; the green hex outlines indicate the three allowed cells. Design the entire roof, walls, eaves, chimney and all appendages inside that plan and comfortably inside the three outlined hexes. Do not reproduce the hexes, outlines, grey fill, green fill or guide background in the output.
Primary request: one continuous very long narrow timber sawmill factory. Three connected industrial timber shed bays along a vertical axis, weathered brown plank roofing, substantial timber ridge beams and little roof vents. Each bay joins directly into the next under continuous walls. All machinery and loading doors are under the existing roof line. No detached equipment, log piles, rail track, yard or exterior platforms.
Material: natural medium BROWN wooden plank or shingle roofing, brown timber walls. All roofs brown, never red or grey.
Composition: EXACTLY ONE complete isolated building centered on a truly transparent background, not a sheet or multiple views. Main long axis VERTICAL. Very slender elongated proportions: approximately 1 unit wide by 6 units long, matching the narrow grey rectangle in the guide. Preserve this narrowness; the three hexes are in a straight vertical line.
Strict orthographic camera directly above the roof, zero perspective, only narrow eave/wall edges. Include all wall details and projected features within the silhouette. Clean alpha zero around the complete building; no ambient halo, soft external shadow or ground shadow. Generous transparent image margins. Painted texture rather than photographic rendering. No text, labels, grids, hex borders, terrain, trees, ground, floor, paving, figures, cars, smoke or detached objects. Do not add an entrance porch outside the guide. The entire sprite must fit inside exactly three cells; this is the primary constraint.

designs.label: 3-hex Stone textile factory
designs.prompt:
Create ONE original painted tactical-game factory sprite inspired by the raised saw-tooth roof architecture in image 1 (the Dalmine detail) and image 2 (Crespi d'Adda). Image 3 supplies ONLY the painted texture, crisp outlines and grey stone palette of this game; do not use its domestic roof architecture. Image 4 supplies only the narrow vertical footprint/proportions inside three hexes; do not draw the guide, any hexes, fills or background.
The subject is one very long narrow STONE TEXTILE FACTORY, with FOUR large, structurally distinct asymmetric SAW-TOOTH SHED ROOF TEETH along its vertical length. Study image 1: each tooth is a real raised triangular prism with a broad shallow opaque roof slope, a sharp high ridge, a STEEP GLASS WALL dropping almost vertically to a dark gutter, and a visible RIGHT-TRIANGULAR END CHEEK. Reproduce that actual construction as one connected industrial building. Show a very clear repeated zigzag silhouette of the triangular roof ends along the RIGHT long side of the factory. The steel-framed glass is the full steep structural face of each triangular tooth, with strong height and depth, NOT skylights or windows laid into a flat roof. Four teeth, all pointing the same way, connected valley to crest in an uninterrupted industrial shed. Roof ridges cross the narrow width. Roof planes SLATE GREY, steep glass faces muted blue-grey, narrow pale stone outer walls. One small round masonry chimney at the upper end, inside the footprint.
Camera: steep bird's-eye orthographic tactical-game sprite, looking down approximately 65 degrees, enough elevation relief to clearly expose the triangular side cheeks and steep glazed planes. Keep the long axis precisely VERTICAL in the image, and the overall silhouette very long and NARROW, approximately 1 unit wide by 5 units long, to match the guide. Keep all roof teeth and walls within that narrow rectangular footprint. Each roof unit must visibly have HEIGHT, like the reference industrial sheds; the image must immediately read as a saw-tooth factory roof, not a long house with rectangular skylight strips. No central domestic gable ridge, hip roof, ordinary gabled-house sections or flat roof bands. Detailed hand-painted small-scale game art, restrained texture and clean dark eave outlines. EXACTLY ONE complete isolated building on genuine alpha transparency. No soft exterior shadow or glow, no ground, paving, props, smoke, other buildings, scene, grid, letters, watermarks or text. Generous transparent margin around the complete building.
